text:
kevin: heads-up — eu-west1c seeing an odd asymmetric gang-lock jitter. small single-GPU pods are getting bounced then a multi-pod gang hits and we get cascading evicts
li: looking at scheduler traces — when a rack-tainted job arrives the scheduler moves tiny pods off one rack to free a contiguous nvlink set, but it only clears half the rack due to a stale taint on some nodes
anika: I grabbed node list and pod placement snapshot
infra-oncall: probe command I ran:
```
kubectl get nodes -l zone=eu-west1c -o custom-columns=NODE:.metadata.name,TAINTS:.spec.taints,TOPO:.metadata.labels.nvidia-topo --no-headers
```
infra-oncall: sample output:
```
node-r1  [{"key":"rack-iso","value":"true","effect":"NoSchedule"}]  nvlink
node-r2  []                                                          nvlink
node-r3  [{"key":"rack-iso","value":"true","effect":"NoSchedule"}]  none
node-r4  []                                                          none
```
kevin: weird — some nodes have the rack-iso taint but also different topo labels. scheduler's packer tries to honor rack isolation + topology, ends up moving pods between r2->r3 and then evicting when gang needs contiguous nvlink on r1+r2 set
li: root cause hypothesis: node-label sync job recently failed on half the rack during a maintenance window, taint cleanup didn't run; autoscaler later added nodes without the rack-iso taint and the mix confuses binpacker
anika: immediate mitigation: 1) pause descheduler/desire compaction in eu-west1c 2) apply a short-term predicate: avoid evicting pods <90s old for consolidation 3) cordon the smallest offender nodes and reconcile taints
packing-bot: descheduler canary paused for eu-west1c by @anika at 6888888890
infra-oncall: running cordon+drain on node-r3 now: `kubectl cordon node-r3 && kubectl drain node-r3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` — moving 7 tiny pods, ETA ~3m
li: scheduler tweak we should do: add a rack-aware packing penalty that prefers keeping tiny pods on mixed taint racks until a full contiguous nvlink set is available; plus a 2m compaction delay before evicting micro-jobs
anika: ops playbook for this event (short):
- cordon/ drain mismatched nodes
- pause compaction/descheduler canaries
- reconcile node taints/labels via node-sync job
- reprovision any nodes missing nvlink labeling
kevin: medium-term actions: pin node-sync job to run post-provision and make taint cleanup idempotent; add an alert that fires when `count(node_taint_mismatch{taint=\"rack-iso\"}) > 2 AND eviction_rate(zone=\"eu-west1c\") > 3/min`
li: cost note: this churn is causing warm-pool churn and an extra ~1.3 GPU node-hours in the last 15m, filing cost blip in the ticket
anika: creating INF ticket with node list, `kubectl describe` dumps, scheduler traces, and the descheduler log snippet. assigning to scheduler + node-health teams
infra-oncall: cordon/drain complete for node-r3, pods rescheduled to warmpool; running a reconciliation pass to ensure taints/labels parity\eol: 6888888920
kevin: thanks all — leaving the thread open until nodes show `rack-iso` parity and eviction rate drops :thumbsup:
